parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Kenpoly-convocation-arena (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1434 | 2.5 | 2.5
2 | 1879 | 5.42 | 7.92
3 | 318 | 18 | 25.9
4 | 3488 | 24.3 | 50.2
5 | 542 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as A-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Kenpoly-convocation-arena (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: A-type
Aquifer depth: 7.92 – 25.9 m (shallow) and > 50.2 m (deep)
Recommendation: Drill to a minimum depth of 60 to 70 m to fully penetrate and exploit the more productive deeper aquifer encountered below 50.2 m. Ensure the highly resistive upper formations are properly cased and screens are positioned within the saturated lower zone.
